key_findings: Curcumin-loaded boronic ester hydrogel (Gel-Cur-M) gave sustained curcumin release and superior analgesia, neuroprotection and anti-inflammation in mouse CCI.
Gel-Cur-M prevented TRPV1 overexpression in DRG and microglial activation and Ccl2/Csf1 induction in the dorsal horn.
